text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After school, for some reason, music could be heard from the dojo.
Peeking inside...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Hah!
...Yeah. This arm motion feels pretty good.
choice_data_list: Are you rehearsing for a play?
Are you rehearsing for a play?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer.
It is true this sword is a stage prop, but...
this is dance practice.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I was experimenting with sword dancing for the solo choreography to see if I could express something unique to myself.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I thought incorporating Western swordsmanship might give it a dignified, knightly dance style.

Ho-ho! Incorporating swordsmanship into dance, is it?
Now that truly is a fascinating idea!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Then Sir Durandal,
would you care to take reference from my swordsmanship as well?"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
A fierce swordsmanship forged to survive Sengoku battles!
It will surely pair splendidly with the music from before!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I see... It's certainly possible
that brand-new choreography could come from this.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Trainer-dono, which one do you think better suits the song we just heard?
choice_data_list: I think a stately, knightly dance would be great!
Maybe a battlefield-like ferocity would suit you.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Understood. In that case, let us continue referencing the knight's sword dance.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, understood!
In that case, at least allow me to observe.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Pouring one's soul into the blade: the stance of stillness.
From this pose—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Shaking it off all at once!
Yaaaarrrghhh!!
choice_data_list: Yeah! The sheer presence was mesmerizing!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
It is an honor, Trainer-dono!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Alright, one more time!
I will master this movement, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after that, Durandal repeated her sword dance until she got the feel for it. Eventually—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Sharpening the mind, quietly keeping the rhythm... and then—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I'll unleash it right here!
HAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oh! What ferocious spirit...
'Tis like a single, lethal blade strike!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Just like a noble knight! Splendid!
choice_data_list: You look so dignified, just like a knight!
You look so dignified, just like a knight, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm humbled by your kind words.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
This dance I have mastered...
Together with my knightly pride, I shall perform it!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Well then, No Reason-san.
I look forward to your guidance.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Is this stance all right?
...And after this—"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: —Deyaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Gah!? Ngh—!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, managed to dodge that, didst thou?
...Unfortunately, I only know the etiquette of the battlefield.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Strike down the foe! That is my swordsmanship!
Taste it to the fullest in real battle! Na-hahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that is the way of your swordsmanship.
Then... allow me to learn from it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after that, their sword fight continued just like a real battle. Eventually—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Step as if you're leaping across a battlefield!
And then—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Dodge in close to the enemy general, quick on your feet!
choice_data_list: Amazing! The sense of motion is incredible!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I'm honored! ...Phew.
This tension feels just like being on a battlefield.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Gahahahaha! That's the spirit!
Thou hast truly taken the way of the battlefield to heart!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I am sure it will be a truly unique solo dance.
Thank you very much, No Reason-san.
